definitions.gloss: bare skin; skin without makeup or covering
definitions.explanation: Skin in its natural state, without cosmetics, foundation, or clothing covering it. Often used in beauty and skincare contexts.

examples.japanese: {素肌|すはだ}がきれいな{人|ひと}だ。
{素肌|すはだ}に{優|やさ}しい{化粧品|けしょうひん}を{選|えら}んでいる。
examples.english: I choose cosmetics that are gentle on bare skin.

examples.japanese: {毎日|まいにち}のスキンケアを{続|つづ}けていたら、{素肌|すはだ}に{自信|じしん}が{持|も}てるようになった。
examples.english: After continuing my daily skincare routine, I became confident in my natural skin.

notes:
Composed of {素|す} (plain, bare, natural) + {肌|はだ} (skin). Frequently used in beauty advertising and skincare discussions. Emphasizes the natural, unadorned state of the skin. The prefix {素|す} implies "without anything added."

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {素肌|すはだ}がきれい: to have beautiful skin
- {素肌|すはだ}に{優|やさ}しい: gentle on the skin
- {素肌|すはだ}{美人|びじん}: natural-skin beauty
- {素肌|すはだ}ケア: bare-skin care
- {素肌|すはだ}に{自信|じしん}がある: to be confident about one's skin

SIMILAR WORDS:
- {肌|はだ}: skin — general term
- すっぴん: no-makeup face — specifically about not wearing makeup on the face
- {生肌|なまはだ}: raw/bare skin — less common, can imply exposed flesh
- {地肌|じはだ}: scalp; bare ground — used for the scalp or surface texture
